item.title: 20 Names That Were Popularized By Movies & TV Shows
item.description: Names are incredibly personal and important, with many parents choosing names that are tied to things they love most. With that, a name can be a tribute to a friend, parent, or other loved one, but it can also be a tribute to something a parent is passionate about.With that in mind, there are plenty of incredible, unique, and unconventional names that appear in film and TV, which then manage to make their way into the regular circulation of new baby names in any given year.
